loads: SELECT l.load_id, l.load_date AS event_date, l.load_status, l.load_type, l.booking_type, l.revenue, l.fuel_surcharge, l.accessorial_charges, c.customer_name, r.origin_city || ' → ' || r.destination_city AS route, r.origin_state, r.destination_state, t.actual_distance_miles, t.fuel_gallons_used, t.driver_id, t.truck_id FROM public.loads l JOIN public.customers c USING (customer_id) JOIN public.routes r USING (route_id) LEFT JOIN public.trips t USING (load_id)
delivery: SELECT e.event_id, e.actual_datetime AS event_date, e.event_type, e.on_time_flag, CASE WHEN e.on_time_flag THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS on_time, e.detention_minutes, f.facility_name, f.city, f.state FROM public.delivery_events e JOIN public.facilities f USING (facility_id)
costs: SELECT purchase_date AS event_date, 'Fuel' AS cost_type, total_cost, truck_id FROM public.fuel_purchases UNION ALL SELECT maintenance_date AS event_date, 'Maintenance' AS cost_type, total_cost, truck_id FROM public.maintenance_records
safety: SELECT incident_id, incident_date AS event_date, incident_type, CASE WHEN preventable_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preventable, vehicle_damage_cost, cargo_damage_cost, claim_amount FROM public.safety_incidents
fleet: SELECT u.month AS event_date, u.truck_id, t.home_terminal, u.utilization_rate, u.downtime_hours, u.total_miles, u.trips_completed FROM public.truck_utilization_metrics u JOIN public.trucks t USING (truck_id)
shipments: SELECT s.id, s."trackingCode" AS tracking_code, s.origin, s.destination, s.status::text AS status, s."createdAt" AS event_date, s."updatedAt" AS last_update, CASE WHEN s.status = 'EXCEPTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exception_count, CASE WHEN s.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' AND s."updatedAt" < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stale_count, CASE WHEN s."driverId" IS NULL AND s.status <> 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unassigned_count FROM public."Shipment" s
branches: SELECT b.code, b.name, b.city, b.country, b.latitude, b.longitude, b."isActive" AS active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public."Shipment" s WHERE s."originBranchId" = b.id) AS outbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public."Shipment" s WHERE s."destinationBranchId" = b.id) AS inbound FROM public."Branch" b
audit: SELECT id, status::text AS status, "createdAt" AS event_date FROM public."StatusLog"
facilities: SELECT f.facility_id, f.facility_name, f.facility_type, f.city, f.state, f.dock_doors, f.latitude::double precision AS latitude, f.longitude::double precision AS longitude FROM public.facilities f
